title: HILTI Injectable Epoxy Mortar 10 – 580/1-A1 | Economical Chemical Anchoring Solution for Concrete Fixing (1)
description: It is a high-performance injectable epoxy mortar specifically engineered for anchoring applications in concrete. This professional-grade adhesive system delivers reliable fastening solutions for both dry and wet base material conditions, making it an essential product for construction and installation projects. The epoxy anchor is designed to work with non-cracked concrete, providing strong and durable bonds that meet demanding structural requirements. Its versatile formulation allows for effective installation in various environmental conditions, ensuring consistent performance whether you're working with dry substrates or wet concrete surfaces. The injectable delivery system enables precise application and optimal distribution within the drilled hole, maximising bond strength and load-bearing capacity. This product is ideal for contractors, engineers, and construction professionals who require dependable anchoring solutions for critical applications. Please note that this product is not suitable for seismic loading applications. Always follow manufacturer guidelines and safety instructions during application and handling.

specifications.Specific Uses For Product: Anchoring In Concrete, Post-installed Reinforcement, Rebar Connections, Structural Bonding, Threaded Rod Anchoring
specifications.Included Components: Injectable Adhesive Cartridge, Static Mixing Nozzle, Dispensing System
